'''''Mirocaw''''' was a rugged [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was operated by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tulkh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The vessel contained various trophies from across Tulkh's career, including the remains of creatures that he had [[Death/Legends|killed]]. In [[3645 BBY]], Tulkh took up an assignment to procure a rare [[Murakami orchid]] for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]] and he flew the vessel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marfa]], where he seized the only living such orchid in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and its [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] handler [[Hestizo Trace]] from a Jedi [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] facility. Tulkh then flew to Scabrous' [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the world [[Odacer-Faustin]], where he handed the Jedi and the plant over to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]. However, Scabrous used the orchid to create a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|deadly disease]], and Tulkh, Trace and the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Pergus Frode]] fled the planet aboard the ''Mirocaw''. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] [[Rance Lussk]] accompanied them, having stowed away aboard the ship, while Tulkh also succumbed to the effects of the disease, and Trace vented the vessel's hold into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in order to defeat them.
